item.title: Version 2.0.0-beta
item.description:
Version 2.0.0 Beta — "Feel Native"

Universal Device Support

  • Auto-detect native digitizer devices (no activation needed)
  • VID-level activation fallback for same-vendor devices
  • Tested on 3 different USB touchscreens (CoolTouch, VID 0x1A86, VID 0x27C6)
  • Generic Desktop X/Y coordinate support for non-standard HID devices

New Gestures

  • Two-finger pinch-to-zoom (dual backend: native CGEvent + keyboard fallback)
  • Two-finger rotation
  • Two-finger horizontal swipe (Back/Forward)
  • Unified momentum engine for scroll and magnify inertia
  • Palm rejection — filters accidental wrist/palm touches

Quality & Stability

  • 177 automated tests (up from 55 in v1.0)
  • Fixed three-finger drag end detection
  • Timer robustness (RunLoop .common mode)
  • Crash-safe CGEvent creation with guard-let

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
Version 1.1.0

  • Double-tap to click is now enabled by default
  • Fixed pointer speed — speed slider now visibly affects cursor velocity
  • 3-finger swipe Back/Forward now works correctly in Finder (Cmd+[/])
